products.title: Malachie Elephant - 296g/11cm
products.body_html:
Malachite 

Malachite is known for its rich green color and distinctive banded patterns that range from light to deep emerald tones. Its swirling layers create bold natural designs, making each piece visually striking and unique.

Because of its vivid color and beautiful patterns, Malachite is commonly used for polished stones, cabochons, carvings, beads, and decorative objects. Its smooth surface and intense green shades make it one of the most recognizable ornamental minerals.

✨ Fact & Fun Fact:
Malachite is a copper carbonate hydroxide mineral with the formula Cu₂CO₃(OH)₂. Its bright green color comes from its high copper content. Malachite has been used since ancient times as a pigment, decorative stone, and copper ore. Some of the most famous deposits are found in the Democratic Republic of Congo, which produces large, beautifully banded specimens

products.title: Malachite  Necklace - 45cm/13mm
products.body_html:
Malachite

Malachite is a stunning copper-rich mineral admired for its vibrant green color and distinctive swirling bands of light and dark green. Its bold natural patterns and silky luster make every piece completely unique, creating one of the most recognizable gemstones in the world.

✨ Metaphysical Context:
Malachite is often associated with transformation, protection, and personal growth. It is believed to encourage positive change, emotional balance, and self-confidence while helping to release old patterns and embrace new opportunities. Many people use Malachite as a stone of courage and renewal.

✨ Fact & Fun Fact:
Malachite is a green Copper carbonate hydroxide mineral. Its vivid green color comes from its high copper content. Malachite has been prized for thousands of years and was used by the ancient Egyptians as both a gemstone and a natural pigment. Important sources include the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Namibia, Australia, Russia, and Zambia.

products.title: Moonstone Mala - 42cm
products.body_html:
Moonstone

Moonstone is a feldspar mineral treasured for its soft glow and shimmering adularescence — a light effect that shifts like moonlight across water. Found in shades of white, cream, peach, and grey, it has been revered for centuries as a stone of intuition, femininity, and new beginnings. Known as the “Stone of the Goddess,” Moonstone enhances emotional balance, nurtures inner wisdom, and strengthens connection to the cycles of the moon. It supports fertility, creativity, and spiritual growth, while protecting sensitive energies. A crystal of mystery and renewal, Moonstone reminds you to trust your intuition and flow with life’s rhythms.

products.title: Moonstone Bowl - 18*12*7cm/2.2kg
products.body_html:
Moonstone

Moonstone is a captivating gemstone admired for its soft white, cream, peach, gray, or rainbow hues and its enchanting floating glow known as adularescence. This shimmering light effect appears to move across the surface of the stone, giving Moonstone its magical and ethereal beauty. Every piece is naturally unique.

✨ Metaphysical Context:
Moonstone is often associated with intuition, new beginnings, and emotional balance. It is believed to encourage inner harmony, self-discovery, and calmness while supporting intuition and personal growth. Many people use Moonstone as a symbol of hope, inspiration, and positive change.

✨ Fact & Fun Fact:
Moonstone is a variety of Feldspar. Its famous glowing effect, known as adularescence, is caused by light scattering between microscopic layers within the crystal. The finest Moonstones are traditionally found in Sri Lanka, while other important sources include India, Madagascar, Tanzania, Myanmar, and Armenia.

products.title: Pagoda (Tower) - Rose Quartz
products.body_html:
Dimension:5.5x5cm Base / 13.5cm Tall / 353g

A pagoda is a traditional multi-tiered tower found across East Asia, especially in China, Japan, Korea, and Vietnam. Pagodas are built in stacked levels, each representing a step toward spiritual wisdom and enlightenment. Their upward-rising shape symbolizes the connection between Earth and the heavens.

Pagodas were originally used as sacred structures to store relics, protect holy texts, and mark spiritual sites. Over time, they became symbols of:

  • Protection (keeping negative energy away)

  • Spiritual elevation (growth, enlightenment, inner development)

  • Stability and balance (a strong, layered foundation)

  • Harmony and peace (aligned energy in space)

Because of these powerful meanings, pagoda-shaped objects — such as carvings, talismans, or figurines — are often used to enhance protection, attract clarity, and support spiritual growth.

Rose Quartz 

Rose Quartz is the stone of unconditional love, emotional healing, and gentle harmony. Its soft pink energy opens the heart, encourages compassion, and brings comfort during times of stress or sadness.

This crystal supports self-love, emotional balance, and the healing of old wounds. Rose Quartz helps attract loving relationships, strengthen existing bonds, and promote kindness toward yourself and others. It is a peaceful companion for restoring harmony and nurturing the heart.

✨ Fact: Rose Quartz has been cherished since ancient times for its calming energy. Known as the “Heart Stone,” it remains one of the most popular crystals for love and emotional healing.

products.title: Bowenite Snake -17cm/538g
products.body_html:
Bowenite (New Jade)

Bowenite, often called New Jade, is the stone of protection, courage, and emotional resilience. Its gentle green glow soothes the heart, calms the mind, and encourages you to move forward with strength and balance. Known as a guardian stone, Bowenite helps release past hurts and empowers you to trust in new beginnings.

This crystal nurtures self-confidence, perseverance, and a deeper connection to inner truth. It is also considered a dream stone, protecting during sleep and encouraging insightful, healing dreams.

✨ Fact: Bowenite is actually a rare variety of serpentine, not true jade. It was first discovered in New Zealand, where it is treasured by the Māori people and traditionally carved into protective amulets.

products.title: Agate Dragon - CA567
products.body_html:
Agate

Agate is a banded variety of chalcedony, a form of quartz, known for its endless colors and intricate patterns. Each piece is unique, often displaying layers that look like flowing landscapes or earthy waves. Found worldwide, Agate has been cherished since ancient times as a stone of stability, strength, and grounding. It harmonizes yin and yang energies, calms the mind, and promotes emotional balance. Agate also enhances focus, patience, and inner security, making it a reliable companion through life’s changes. A gentle yet steady stone, Agate reminds you to move with balance and grace.
